features: YouTube H.264 video streaming playback directly inside the MiniPlayer and Fullscreen Player via native ExoPlayer Texture

Fixed background auto-next playback, real-time notification/lock-screen seekbar & state updates, Dynamic Island alert pill sizing, Artist/Album verified badges, and Smart Queue isolation
improvements: Improved MiniPlayer-to-Fullscreen seamless video surface handoff with smooth aspect-ratio rendering
